inputs.text: DHS wants people to see this as proof that New York City’s policies are dangerous, but that framing is doing a lot of work. The department says ICE arrested a gang member after city authorities released him; we’re only hearing the version that serves the federal crackdown. Turning one case into a warning about sanctuary policies shifts attention from how officials choose to present these incidents—and who benefits when fear is used to justify stronger immigration enforcement.

output.main_topic: DHS framing an ICE arrest as evidence that New York City’s policies are dangerous
